thread:
Sophie: Quick copy review — new empty state + tooltip for the Export Insights flow. Screenshot attached: https://img.redwood.dev/exports-ux.png

Liam: nice, can you paste the proposed lines?

Sophie: Sure. Drafts below: Tooltip: "Export insights to CSV. Includes per-route cost and latency."
Empty state headline: "No exports yet"
Empty state body: "Create an export to analyze token usage and latency across your routes."
CTA: "Create export"

Maya: my 2¢: prefer sentence case for headline (looks fine). For tooltip, shorten and be explicit about format: "Download CSV of token usage and latency." Also accessibility: button needs aria-describedby or aria-label for screen readers.

Arjun: Agree with shortening. Also the empty state body can be tighter: "Export a CSV to inspect token costs and latency over time." CTA could be "Start export" instead of "Create export".

Sophie: Updated suggestion: 
```
Tooltip (aria-label): "Download CSV of token usage and latency"
Empty state headline: "No exports yet"
Empty state body: "Export a CSV to analyze token cost and latency for your project."
CTA: "Create an export"
```

Liam: tiny wording nit: "Create export" feels a bit terse. I prefer "Create an export" or "Start export". Leaning "Create an export" for clarity.

Maya: accessibility nit: CTA should include aria-label: "Create an export for token cost and latency analysis" so screen readers get context. Also make sure tooltip is keyboard-focusable.

Sophie: Also adding error copy for failed exports: current draft "Export failed. Try again or contact support." Better to be slightly more helpful: "Export failed. Try again later or contact support@redwood.com." Retry button label: "Retry export".

Designbot: Preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.dev/exports (automated preview build #234) :rocket:

Arjun: LGTM overall. One more microcopy tweak — replace "Try again later" with simply "Try again" to avoid promising a time.

Sophie: Ok final agreed copy: 
- Tooltip (aria-label): "Download CSV of token usage and latency"
- Empty state headline: "No exports yet"
- Empty state body: "Export a CSV to analyze token cost and latency for your project."
- CTA: "Create an export" (aria-label: "Create an export for token cost and latency analysis")
- Error: "Export failed. Try again or contact support@redwood.com." Retry label: "Retry export"

Liam: looks good, thanks. I'll update the console copy PR after figma gets the changes. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks Sophie — I'll add the accessibility notes in the component spec.

Sophie: filing follow-up tasks in the design board and updating the PR.
